'''Cha'nagh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Flesh Raider]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Cha'nagh had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and pink-colored skin, utilized a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] in combat, and wore thick, silver-colored shoulder [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="TOR" /> During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], the Flesh Raider was serving with<ref name="TOR" /> an [[Flesh Raider army|army]] formed by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]], who was leading a [[Flesh Raider uprising|campaign]] against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]].<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> Around the start of the fighting, Cha'nagh was stationed with two Flesh Raider [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] at a small camp in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region of the planet.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
While Cha'nagh was in the Gnarls, an individual affiliated with the Galactic Republic came upon the camp and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Flesh Raider.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Cha'nagh appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]]. In the game, the Flesh Raider is a low-level boss in the Gnarls area on Tython, the starting planet for the [[Jedi Consular]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] classes. However, any Republic player class&mdash;[[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]], [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]], [[Voidhound|Smuggler]], or [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Trooper]]&mdash;can kill Cha'nagh. Since this article was written with the assumption of 100 percent game completion, this article states that Cha'nagh was killed but does not specify an individual. Though not mentioned in-game, the game's character model is explicitly labeled as Male instead of Neutral.<ref name="TOR" />
